2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences u/s 341, 323, 406, 498A of the IPC and  of the D.P. Act 3.

A mediation report dated 29.11.2024 is kept at Flag 'M'.
4.

I perused the said mediation report in Mediation Proceeding No.1618 of 2024, whereby the learned Mediator has submitted that the dispute between the parties has been resolved through the process of Mediation and the terms of settlement mutually agreed upon by them is being attached with the report.

5. Considering the mediation report, let the above named Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.46790 of 2024(4) dt.09-12-2024 petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his/her arrest or surrender Manoj Rai vs The State Of Bihar on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113799616/
1 before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/Successor Court in connection with Complaint Case No.3053 of 2019, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2)
of the Cr.P.C.
